changelog: v0.3.6: Fixed on-device Whisper STT: 1) Replaced audio looping with silent zero-gain mute node to prevent feedback loops; 2) Adjusted voice detection threshold from 0.02 to 0.007 with adaptive sensitivity; 3) Added 350ms pre-speech rolling audio ring buffer to preserve leading phonemes; 4) Fixed acoustic echo guard false rejections when assistant is silent; 5) Push-to-talk auto-finalize when tapping mic button; 6) Added clear transcription progress status.
